newsitem.title: CHINA: China hikes LPG prices by 50 pct to 1,200 yuan/T.
newsitem.headline: China hikes LPG prices by 50 pct to 1,200 yuan/T.

text.p: China has increased the ex-refinery price for liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) by 50 percent to 1,200 yuan ($145) per tonne effective from October 18, officials said on Friday.

An official of the cabinet's State Planning Commission told Reuters by telephone that the ex-refinery price of LPG has been raised to 1,200 yuan effective from October 18. He declined to provide further details.
A spokesman for the state refinery China Petrochemical Corp (Sinopec) said the previous ex-refinery price of LPG was 800 yuan.
